description: RE-Safe tests a two-thirds-scale concrete frame with an external cross-laminated-timber skin connected through friction dampers. Six configurations vary panel symmetry and damper-bolt tightening. Earthquake motions of increasing intensity are interspersed with dynamic-identification tests. Floor and panel accelerations, damper displacements and optical floor movements support retrofit modelling. The dataset is provided by LNEC, Lisbon through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2024. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0.
